Class PythonStubGenerator

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.PythonStubGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Ordered, Toggleable, TypeElementVisitor<Object,Object>
public class PythonStubGenerator extends Object implements TypeElementVisitor<Object,Object>
Generates Java stubs for Python classes, scripts, enums, interfaces, and annotations.
